import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[][] delta = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int start_node, end_node, edge_idx=1, grid_dim, max_time, INF, adjacency[], q_buf[], edges[][], dep_map[][], dist_map[][], point_id[][], supply_id[][];
    static char gridA[][], gridB[][];
    static final int MAX_NODES = 1000;
    static final int MAX_EDGES = 2000000;
    static int[] flow_array;
    static List<Integer>[] adj;
    static List<int[]> edges_list;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        grid_dim = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        max_time = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        gridA = new char[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        gridB = new char[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        point_id = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        supply_id = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        dep_map = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        dist_map = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            String lineA = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = lineA.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            String lineB = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = lineB.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        adjacency = new int[MAX_NODES + 1];
        q_buf = new int[1000000];
        edges = new int[MAX_EDGES + 1][3];
        dep_map = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        dist_map = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        point_id = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];
        supply_id = new int[grid_dim + 1][grid_dim + 1];

        for (int[] row : dep_map) Arrays.fill(row, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for (int[] row : dist_map) Arrays.fill(row, Integer.MAX_VALUE);

        // Initialize adjacency list
        adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_NODES; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int t = 1;
        start_node = 0;
        end_node = 1;

        // Run BFS for 'Z' cells
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    run_bfs(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        // Copy dep_map to dist_map
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                dep_map[i][j] = dist_map[i][j];
            }
        }

        // Assign point and supply IDs
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    point_id[i][j] = ++t;
                    add_edge(start_node, t, gridA[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (gridB[i][j] > '0' && gridB[i][j] <= '9') {
                    supply_id[i][j] = ++t;
                    add_edge(t, end_node, gridB[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // Run BFS for point cells
        for (int i = 1; i <= grid_dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= grid_dim; j++) {
                if (point_id[i][j] != 0) {
                    run_bfs(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }

        int total = 0;
        while (build_path()) {
            total += max_flow(start_node, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        }
        System.out.println(total);
    }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        edges[++edge_idx][0] = v;
        edges[edge_idx][1] = capacity;
        edges[edge_idx][2] = adjacency[u];
        adjacency[u] = edge_idx;

        edges[++edge_idx][0] = u;
        edges[edge_idx][1] = 0;
        edges[edge_idx][2] = adjacency[v];
        adjacency[v] = edge_idx;
    }

    static void run_bfs(int x, int y, boolean check) {
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        int id = point_id[x][y];
        q_buf[l] = x * 1000 + y;
        for (int[] row : dist_map) Arrays.fill(row, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        dist_map[x][y] = 0;
        while (l <= r) {
            int val = q_buf[l++];
            int X = val / 1000;
            int Y = val % 1000;
            if (check && supply_id[X][Y] != 0 && dist_map[X][Y] <= max_time && dist_map[X][Y] <= dep_map[X][Y]) {
                add_edge(id, supply_id[X][Y], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            if (dist_map[X][Y] > max_time || dist_map[X][Y] >= dep_map[X][Y]) continue;
            if (id == 3 && supply_id[X][Y] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dist_map[X][Y]);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = X + delta[i][0];
                int ny = Y + delta[i][1];
                if (nx > 0 && nx <= grid_dim && ny > 0 && ny <= grid_dim && gridA[nx][ny] >= '0' && gridA[nx][ny] <= '9' && dist_map[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                    dist_map[nx][ny] = dist_map[X][Y] + 1;
                    q_buf[++r] = nx * 1000 + ny;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean build_path() {
        flow_array = new int[MAX_NODES + 1];
        Arrays.fill(flow_array, 0);
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        q_buf[l] = start_node;
        flow_array[start_node] = 1;
        while (l <= r) {
            int x = q_buf[l++];
            for (int i = adjacency[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i][2]) {
                int y = edges[i][0];
                if (flow_array[y] != 0 || edges[i][1] == 0) continue;
                flow_array[y] = flow_array[x] + 1;
                q_buf[++r] = y;
                if (y == end_node) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int max_flow(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == end_node) return flow;
        int rem = flow;
        for (int i = adjacency[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i][2]) {
            int y = edges[i][0];
            if (flow_array[y] != flow_array[x] + 1 || edges[i][1] == 0) continue;
            int pushed = max_flow(y, Math.min(rem, edges[i][1]));
            rem -= pushed;
            edges[i][1] -= pushed;
            edges[i ^ 1][1] += pushed;
            if (rem == 0) return flow;
        }
        if (rem == flow) flow_array[x] = -1;
        return flow - rem;
    }
}
